_provenance.rule: per-cohort recompute via ratio-of-sums / pooled median / drive-day weighting; no baked corpus-wide arrays; empty cohorts -> nulls, never zero-as-real; comparison type gated by dependency class; rates expose paired_n/paired_km (M291); energy rates and the adjusted energy contrast use canonical-clean eligibility (ens_invalid/ens_outlier_v2 excluded; M295)

comparisonPrimitives.scalar_dumbbell: per-cohort scalar with warm-relative delta + CI (CI when >=2 cohorts have support)

frozenCharts.CalibrationCard: current-sensor offset / sign convention — manifest constant, fixed under filter
frozenCharts.ExposureTotalsCard: distance / gross-throughput totals — exposure, labelled 'Exposure total' not a rate

stagedCharts.SocHysteresisChart: fitted SoC-control surface (m119v2) — needs per-cohort refit (degenerate without cold data)
stagedCharts.BufferImpulseChart: per-second engine-start SoC/current transients — needs raw current+engine-state extraction
stagedCharts.RampLatencyChart: per-second engine-on→target-RPM latency — needs raw RPM+engine-state extraction
stagedCharts.CycleProjectionChart: seasonalAssumptions extrapolation — model, labelled separately from observed

commonSupport.method: categorical strata + propensity min-max overlap + overlap-weight ESS

warm_vs_shoulder.estimand: average B-minus-A difference over the common-support population (shared strata and propensity overlap); not the pooled-corpus ATE
warm_vs_shoulder.interpretation: seasonal operating difference standardized to the common-support composition; may include unmeasured cabin-heating/defrost demand (no HVAC telemetry)
